correctness.rationale: The exact quartic equilibrium reduction P(x,r) uses y=5x/D and z=x(r+x)/D, D=2x²+rx+5-r², valid with D>29/10 on the critical rectangle. I independently recomputed disc_x P=12000 H(r) and P(0,r)=(r²−5)(2r²−5r−10). Four real discriminant roots are near −2.011934533, −1.308660544, 2.188758627 and 3.355161061; negative fold r_f≈−1.30866054409147 and transcritical r_t=(5−√105)/4≈−1.31173769148990 have gap ≈0.00307714739843. Exact rational Sturm and the proof’s uniform P_xx>12, P_r>28, endpoint positivity show two and only two positive x roots for r_t<r<r_f, with no extra real roots by root-count continuity. The equilibrium Jacobian satisfies det(J)=−x P_x/D on P=0, independently checked symbolically modulo P; its trace −8, principal-minor a2>12 and |a3|<7 give a sink at x_+ and one-unstable saddle at x_−. The origin polynomial and Routh–Hurwitz prove sink until r_t; nonzero x branch crosses the origin transversally at r_t. The global Lyapunov family V_u=1/2(ux²+y²+(2−u)z²), whose quadratic nonlinear derivative cancels, has negativity condition Phi(u,r)<1; strict convex minimization and resultant r^4 H(r) identify the same r_f as its exact negative threshold. A strict negative definite weighted symmetric linear part proves global exponential attraction for r_f<r≤0, not merely local stability. Verification script’s rational Sturm/inequality assertions were materially inspected; finite numerical eigenvalues were not used for interval proofs.
